expectations.note: Four ordinary player sets; not a selected three-seat count.

Seven printed identities: Convincing Argument (2), Dagger (2), Diplomacy (1), Dune, the Desert Planet (2), Reconnaissance (1), Seek Allies (1), Signet Ring (1). Four boxed player sets give 40 copies; setup I p.5 uses one per participant.
Alphabetical list has 11 left and 11 right; corroborated by I pp.17–18. This is a location count, not 22 cards.
Four Faction Alliance tokens; placement I p.4.
Shared Mentat; placement I p.4.
Three identical per-player Control marker flags shown on I p.3; this is a per-player component count, not an additional boxed count.
Reference cards, not Uprising Rival cards.
Control the Spice, one per player in Epic mode; not standard deck.
Two Experimentation copies replace two Dune, the Desert Planet; setup M p.5.
Separate contrasting-back contracts; not in ordinary 20-contract pool.
Two distinct 10-card Commander starting decks.
Not part of ordinary 18-card Bloodlines Intrigue pool.
Seven wood and seven plastic alternative representations; only seven used, not fourteen units.
Four of six require Tech Module.
One of six requires Tech Module.
Selected from the 18 boxed cards; unused cards return to the box.
Selected from the 18 boxed cards; unused cards return to the box.
Selected from the 18 boxed cards; unused cards return to the box.
Selected from the 18 boxed cards; unused cards return to the box.
Four player-color copies of Control the Spice; one per player in Epic mode. Excluded from Standard.
Four player-color sets of two Experimentation copies. The separate per-player replacement recipe applies at setup.
Four ordinary player-color ten-card decks. Seven printed identities have per-player multiplicities 2+2+1+2+1+1+1; no face semantics inferred.
Convincing Argument (2), Dagger (2), Diplomacy (1), Dune, the Desert Planet (2), Reconnaissance (1), Seek Allies (1), Signet Ring (1). One deck is used per participant.
